description: This file implements the NeedMediaData class, which manages media data requests, including initialization with shared memory buffers, validation, and sending notifications to a media pipeline client within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: NeedMediaData
classes.description: A class responsible for managing media data requests, including initialization, validation, and communication with media pipeline clients.

methods.name: NeedMediaData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the media data request, setting up shared memory info and validation based on media type and playback state.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a media data request notification to the media pipeline client if valid.
